The '''Talisman of the Burra Fish''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Talisman of Transformation]] that granted the user the power to [[Metamorphosis|turn into]] a [[Burra fish/Legends|burra fish]]. [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] briefly mentioned its existence in her manifesto ''[[Wild Power]]''.
